notes.title: Mini Settlers 1.0 is OUT NOW! | Launch Discount -30%
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The moment we’ve all been waiting for has finally arrived—Mini Settlers v1.0 is officially LIVE on Steam! 
To celebrate, we're launching with a 30% discount for a limited time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521630/Mini_Settlers/

[h1]What's in the 1.0 update?[/h1]

[h3]NEW BIOMES[/h3]
Explore a richer, more diverse world with the introduction of three distinct biomes:

• Plains: A vibrant and fertile landscape ideal for early expansion, offering a balanced mix of resources and space to grow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/0303a348d1634e5628f2338837c57e566220410f.png[/img]

• Snow: A frigid, snow-covered region where survival is tougher, but valuable resources like pine and rare minerals make the risk worth it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/24f9a1e02ac3e9257d98e25d1a0830d51513252c.png[/img]

• Desert: A dry and unforgiving environment that puts your planning to the test, with scarce water, intense heat, and exclusive resources like oil and gold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/12b221ebd77c744a40f09e945f11fd2399054844.png[/img]

Each biome brings its own unique layout, visual style, and strategic challenges, encouraging new ways to build, expand, and thrive.

[h3]20+ NEW BUILDINGS[/h3]
We've more than doubled your construction options! From advanced industry, New production chains, to Unique biome-specific buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/792659c6edae919d07f2c84901e34682e9e22978.png[/img]

[h3]Production Switching[/h3]
Fine-tune your logistics like never before.
Now, you can click on any production building that supports multiple recipes to change what it’s making. This gives you more control and flexibility in adapting to your city’s evolving needs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/85dc09eb1c4eadc1bf903ace9ca7577ee547a522.gif[/img]

[h3]Custom City Requests[/h3]
Tired of your city demanding the same resources over and over? Now you’re in charge!
Click on any City Center to manually change the resource being requested by all the houses in that city.
On their next request cycle, every house will switch to the new resource.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/f8d18d981d3ce1a44615b4045f0847d764a37d63.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW CAMPAIGN[/h3]
Rework the campaign adding new levels featuring the new biomes with different challenges to overcome along the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/8a896a9ce3b01f0e9bd5d7520ad1ba3f0ae27f09.png[/img]

[h3]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS AND STEAM COMMUNITY ITEMS[/h3]
Celebrate your progress with a whole new set of Steam achievements!
[list]
[*] Earn badges for reaching new milestones
[*] Collect trading cards and backgrounds
[*] Customize your profile with emoticons and more
[/list]

Also, the game is Steam Deck Playable! Enjoy the game seamlessly on your Steam Deck for a great portable experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/cacf89e39bdcfc4b788af671f19c8f250d1917ad.png[/img]


[h2]⚠️ Important Note About Save Files ⚠️[/h2]
Please note that v1.0 is not compatible with previous save games.
If you want to finish your current Early Access save before switching:
[olist]
[*] Right-click Mini Settlers in your Steam library
[*] Select Properties
[*] Go to the Betas tab
[*] Choose the "EarlyAccess_Build" branch
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/ea09203e57aaaeef48761faaf18b5a4ec3b4ac94.png[/img]


[h2]ChangeLog[/h2]
[b][Added][/b]
[list]
[*] Two new biomes: Snow and Desert
[*] Pine Trees, a new tree type that grows in the Snow biome
[*] Oil, a new resource found in the Desert biome, used for producing flammables
[*] Gold Ore, a rare resource available in the Desert biome
[*] City progression system: Cities of the next tier now require workers from the previous tier to function and will add more population to their houses
[*] Production switching: Some buildings now support multiple production recipes that players can easily switch between
[*] Custom city requests: Click on any City Center to manually change the resource requested by all houses in that city. All houses will switch to the new request on their next cycle
[*] Biome-specific quests to unlock population in each region
[*] Level descriptions added for better context and progression clarity
[*] UI scaling option added in the settings menu
[*] New Campaign Mode with 16 handcrafted levels
[*] 30+ new Sandbox levels for free-form building and experimentation
[*] 20+ new buildings across all three biomes
[*] Two new Languages Traditional Chinese and Turkish
[/list]
[b][Fixed][/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved several issues with stations and highways that caused resources to get stuck
[/list]
[b][Improved][/b]
[list]
[*] Population UI now displays detailed distribution across all biomes and city levels
[*] Storage resource selection UI redesigned for better usability
[*] Level selection menu completely revamped with a cleaner and more modern design
[/list]

Get the Game with 30% Discount
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521630/Mini_Settlers/

And you can also get the game as a part of these Bundles and if you own any part of them just complete your set to save even more!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43841/Minimalist_Automation/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53578/Mini_Settlers__Old_Market_Simulator/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53577/Mini_Settlers__Tiny_Pasture/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44004/Terra_Settlers/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41791/Goblinz_City_Builders/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47085/Thriving_City_Song__Mini_Settlers/

We’re eager to hear your feedback! Join the discussion on Discord and let us know what you think about the new mechanics, biomes, and balance changes.
[url=https://discord.gg/cMWYgE5Tce][b]we are counting on your feedback on Discord[/b][/url] to report any bugs or suggestions you may have to improve the game as much as we can!

Thank you so much for supporting us throughout Early Access.
We can't wait to see the worlds you build in 1.0 and beyond!

Knight Owl Games and Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: Experimental Branch Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]


We’ve got some exciting news! The Experimental Branch is now live, bringing major gameplay improvements, new biomes, and expanded mechanics. This update represents the final iteration of our experimental build before the official launch, and we’d love for you to jump in and share your thoughts!

It's recommended that you've played the main game for a couple of hours before going into the Experimental Branch.


[b]What’s New?[/b]
[list]
[*] Two New multi-biomes Maps: One medium and one large map to test different playstyles and biomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/efbbe8552b1b08bf25eed6dd9da4aecb88231a9a.png[/img]

[*] 15+ New Buildings: Expanding your city’s possibilities with more variety and depth.
[*] New Biomes & Population Quests: Three distinct biomes bring unique population types, challenges and dependencies.
[list]
[*] [b]Plain Biome[/b]
[*] [b]Desert Biome[/b]
[*] [b]Snow Biome[/b]
[/list]

[*] Dynamic House Requests: You can now change the resources houses consume via the city center.
[*] Interdependent Population System: Higher-tier cities now rely on lower-tier cities, encouraging multi-city management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/89a5f4b7bfe748fcdd150cb006dcec958037f001.png[/img]

[*] Multiple Production Recipes: Some production buildings now support different crafting options (e.g., juice makers can use apples or dates).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/43b8e3130617ea66eee7608f7b1a76250a81f4b4.png[/img]

[*] Improved Game Balance & Polish: Fine-tuned resource colors, building visuals, and overall game balance.
[/list]


How to Access the Experimental Branch?
[olist]
[*] Right-click the game in your Steam Library.
[*] Go to Properties > Betas.
[*] Select the Experimental branch from the dropdown menu.
[*] Update your game and start playing!
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/ea09203e57aaaeef48761faaf18b5a4ec3b4ac94.png[/img]

We're officially Steam Deck Playable! Enjoy the game seamlessly on your Steam Deck for a great portable experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/cacf89e39bdcfc4b788af671f19c8f250d1917ad.png[/img]

We’re eager to hear your feedback! Join the discussion on discord and let us know what you think about the new mechanics, biomes, and balance changes. Thanks for being part of this journey, and happy building!
[url=https://forms.gle/8b2TQLHWBKHcN3nN8]For the feedback regarding the new Experimental Branch use this link.[/url]


Also we're a part of the Spring Sale! Get the game at a 30% discount for a limited time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521630/Mini_Settlers/

Thanks for playing and have a nice day,
-Knight Owl Games & Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: Helipad and Overlay Update (v0.3)
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,

We're excited to share our newest update with you the [b]Helipad and Overlay Update[/b] (v0.3) now you can fly over your buildings while getting detailed insights across your island.[/h3]

[h2]Added Overlay and Resources Dashboard System[/h2]
Get detailed insights across your island, from population satisfaction to production efficiency, and pinpoint traffic issues affecting resources. New features include:
[list]
[*][b]Resources Dashboard:[/b] View total demand, production, and current production of any selected resource, along with overlays for input, output, and storage locations.
[*][b]Population Satisfaction Overlay:[/b] Monitor the population satisfaction levels in cities and houses.
[*][b]Production Efficiency Overlay:[/b] Check how efficiently production buildings are performing.
[*][b]Road Traffic Overlay:[/b] Identify high-traffic roads that may be slowing down your island.
[*][b]Station Efficiency Overlay:[/b] Monitor the capacity of individual stations.
[*][b]Warehouse Capacity Overlay:[/b] Track storage levels across warehouses.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/4dfa97d8c913d1bfb664c76ad159d8d3801eebac.gif[/img]

[h2]Helipad Stations[/h2]
Build Helipad Stations to move a lot of resources in bulk between them above everything in a straight line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/58aedd5ca4f31b339cbfe2873648de0f8c38e5e6.gif[/img]


[h2]Train Tunnels[/h2]
Rails can now pass through mountains with newly added tunnel capabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/b5517fc47cb97d3cdd4195de638ae8caf3f7a365.gif[/img]

[h2]3 New Sandbox Levels[/h2]
Explore three unique levels designed to showcase the new helipad stations and tunnel-enabled trains, including a special level set entirely in caves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/2d72a2ed38574e11e7240c7a724ed72984e40536.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/f0ac11515bb1899934590148a5be07d810bbb71e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/77f2b7a7a21649347432806396e397d3aaba0a10.png[/img]

V0.3 ChangeLog:
[h3][b][Added][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Helipad Stations to move a lot of resources in bulk between them above everything in a straight line.
[*] Overlay and Resources Dashboard System
[*] "Back to Campaign" button in the Game Over Screen after completing a level.
[*] Train Rails can now tunnel under the mountains.
[*] Photo Mode to hide the UI for screenshots (use Steam F12) or recording.
[*] UI Tooltips for all in-game buttons and icons.
[*] Option to delete station roads directly from the station post.
[*] Incoming Resources will get highlighted when selecting a building.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/a3501847339b9e0328e8cae3297a55b37d262c9b.gif[/img]


[h3][b][Updated][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Game Over screen messaging for clarity on level completion.
[*] Reduced population requirements for tutorial completion.
[*] Game Over screen will now reappear upon completing all level quests.
[*] Adjusted road speeds and building production rates for better balance.
[/list]

[h3][b][Fixed][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Roads not highlighted correctly when a road post is held during construction.
[*] Dividing roads occasionally forming loops, causing gameplay issues.
[*] Resource ordering system bug where items wouldn't reorder as expected.
[*] Road “ghosting” issue after destruction.
[*] Achievement system bug preventing the tutorial achievement from unlocking (this will now unlock if you've completed the tutorial).
[*] Occasional resource delivery bug affecting homes.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521630/Mini_Settlers/

[b]Also Check out our newest bundle:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47085/Thriving_City_Song__Mini_Settlers/

[b]Want to help Mini Settlers grow?[/b]
Steam Reviews really help! As a tiny team, reviews encourage players and content creators to give the game a chance. Please do take a moment to fill out a short review, even if it's only a few words. It just might make a big difference.

Thanks for playing and have a nice day,
-Knight Owl Games & Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: In Game Timer - Patch #2 (v 0.1.2)
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone,[/h2]

After a community discussion over [b]the Steam discussion forum and our Discord server[/b], we decided to [b]remove the time limits from the levels quests, and make the in-game timer disabled by default.[/b]

If you want to view the real-time timer in the game or to view your best time feature in the game over menu or level selection in the main menu all you have to do is go to [b]Options ->  Game and enable the in-game timer.[/b]
[Note your best time will be recorded either way but will be hidden if the timer is disabled]

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]
[b]Removed:
[/b]- Time limits from levels quests.

[b]Modified:
[/b]- The in-game timer is now disabled by default if you want to see your best time you have to enable it from the options menu.
- Road drivers' color design to help differentiate them from the road posts.

[h2]Special Thanks to our community members:[/h2]
Baker, cytospin, Hyruga, Sol, Kaganis, Steam Dad, Hart, Measure, ShakyChicken, Darth Phaser, ThatBeADragon, Silden, Tikupoiss, DariganZ, baron, and bz-mof

Thanks for playing and have a nice day,
-Knight Owl Games & Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: Free Prologue Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=L0icQvreDgI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone,

[h3]The free prologue of Mini Settlers is out now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788870/Mini_Settlers_Prologue/

For those who have played the demo, here are all the changes and new features we have implemented since the last build.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3]Game feel[/h3]

[list][*] Overall color palette and design.
[*] Game UI and UX improvements.
[*] New music and sound effects.[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list][*] Resources will now get destroyed if their path is disconnected.
[*] All quarries and mines now contain infinite resources.
[*] Farms, quarries, and mines now operate based on the number of resources surrounding them.
[*] Each city center now holds a local population of its houses.
[*] Trees can now be removed using the destroy tool.
[*] Cities with different levels now have different colors.
[*] Foresters now directly plant trees without a progress bar.
[*] New designs for the first and second maps.[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list][*] A new onboarding tutorial.
[*] A Handy Handbook containing tips and useful information.
[*] A new method for building roads using road anchors.
[*] New resources.
[*] New building types and sizes.
[*] Icons on buildings to indicate their current status (paused, in production, or prioritized).
[*] Notifications to alert the player why a building can't be placed in the current position.[/list]

[h3]Options[/h3]

[list][*] Full localization in 12 languages.
[*] A "Play in Background" option.
[*] Game credits.
[*] More control options: [F] to start a new road -- [E] to open the build menu -- [Q] to open the tools menu.
[*] New buttons for all the tools.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/cacf89e39bdcfc4b788af671f19c8f250d1917ad.png[/img]

The game is fully playable on the Steam Deck with an official controller layout that should be loaded at the start.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788870/Mini_Settlers_Prologue/

Your feedback is really important to us. You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/fWVrAExjva]Discord server[/url] to share yours. 
If you enjoy this free version of the game, please consider leaving a positive review as it will help us a lot moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429329/53b1ba4605b1f4b1f7f6cd4f5d06ec339153ff6e.png[/img]
[i]A glimpse of what awaits you...[/i]

Have fun, and thank you for your support!

-Knight Owl Games & Goblinz Publishing
